fields.Name: T343 - Labels Scope and Status Filter Popover
fields.Description: Uses mj-filter-popover + mj-filter-panel driven by the dynamically-built FilterFields getter (scope/status options with counts) and OnScopeFilterChange/OnStatusFilterChange — distinct from the inline chip filter used on the Graph surface.

InputDefinition.goal: In the Version History app → Labels surface, click the Filters button in the toolbar to open the filter popover. Confirm it shows a Scope filter and a Status filter. Select a value in one of them and confirm the active-filter indicator updates and the list responds (narrows or shows a no-results state). Then clear the filters. Pages can take 10-30s to load — wait, don't navigate away.

judgeValidationCriteria: The Filters popover opens showing Scope and Status filter controls
Selecting a filter value updates the active-filter indicator/badge and the list responds
Clearing the filters restores the list or base empty state
No error messages, blank screens, or crash pages
